activities.body: Services agreement signed by Sam Delacroix (Director of Operations). Scope: two agents — an operations desk agent and a field reporting agent — each in its own channel. Governance: a quarterly review with MultiAgency.
Q1 review held with Sam Delacroix. Both agents in production. No scope change was requested and no actions were recorded.
Signed amendment received. Scope reduced from two agents to one: the field reporting agent is retired, effective 2026-07-01. Reason recorded by Vireo: the field team was reorganised.
Q2 review held. One agent in production. Sam Delacroix asked whether the field reporting agent could be restored later in the year. No decision was taken at the review.
Signed amendment received restoring the field reporting agent, effective 2026-09-01. Scope returns to two agents.
